## Samsung Electronics Sets Record H1 R&D and Capital Expenditure in South Korea

Record H1 R&D and capex simultaneously signals Samsung is in an all-in catch-up cycle — a near-term margin headwind but a medium-term competitive threat to SK Hynix in HBM and to TSMC in foundry. Watch whether spend translates to yield improvement and share recapture.

- Samsung Electronics has lifted both R&D and capex to record levels in the first half of the year, per Chosunbiz.
- The simultaneous records across R&D and capex signal broad-based investment commitment, not just manufacturing scale.
- The investment surge is framed as an aggressive response to competitive pressure in semiconductors.
- No specific R&D or capex figures are disclosed in the headline.
